attributes.board_name: New York State Education Department, Office of the Professions – State Board for Physical Therapy

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses (incl. self-study and online, no limit) from NYSED-approved sponsors in approved subject areas; 1 contact hour = 50 minutes, 1 CEU = 10 contact hours. Other credit per the Department: college credit course (15 h per credit hour), teaching/presenting for an approved sponsor (2 h per contact hour), peer-reviewed article or book chapter (15 h), specialty certification (10 h initial, 5 h recert), clinical instructor (0.5 h per 2-week period per student, max 10 h per period), 12-month residency/fellowship (36 h), peer-reviewed poster/platform (5 h), CPR with AED from AHA/Red Cross (2 h), passing the NY law test (2 h). Courses designed only to maximize practice profits are not accepted.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Exempt during the first triennial registration period after licensure. Registration periods shorter than 3 years (proration to birth-month renewal) require 1 hour per month.
rules.audit_note: Attest on the registration renewal; keep certificates 6 years. Random audits; self-reporting forms are not accepted as proof. Conditional one-year registration possible to make up a deficit.
rules.legal_basis: Education Law Article 136; Regulations of the Commissioner §77.10
rules.notes: No mandatory topics. Same 36 hours for physical therapists and physical therapist assistants. The free online NY 'Test Your Knowledge of Law and Practice' gives 2 hours if all answers are correct.
rules.rule_quote: During each triennial registration period, meaning a registration period of three years' duration, an applicant for registration shall complete at least 36 hours of continuing education, acceptable to the department, as defined in paragraph (2) of this subdivision.
